name: Ohio University
academic_ranking: Public research university in Athens, OH, founded in 1804 (the first university established in the former Northwest Territory). Carnegie-classified R1 (Doctoral Universities - Very high research). U.S. News ranked it #198 nationally (tie); noted subject strengths include Fine Arts, Rehabilitation Counseling, and Physical Therapy, plus nationally recognized journalism, business, and medicine programs. Home to the Heritage College of Osteopathic Medicine. Athens campus enrollment about 24,900 (roughly 19,100 undergraduates) as of fall 2023. Academic profile gathered from en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ohio_University checked 2026-07.
financial_aid: Ohio University Athens Campus 2026-2027 annual undergraduate tuition and fees: Ohio residents (in-state) $15,018; out-of-state residents $26,792. The tuition field above uses the in-state resident rate ($15,018); out-of-state is $26,792. These figures cover tuition and fees only, not room, meals, or other costs. Program- and team-specific financial aid/gift aid figures were not published on the pages checked. Source: ohio.edu/admissions/tuition checked 2026-07.

The 2026 softball coaching staff consists of a head coach and two assistant coaches.
